title: Electrocompetent E. coli Preparation Protocol
author: Alba Balletbó
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7jrhkm6

steps.title: Grow starter culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate 5 mL of LB without salts and incubate overnight.

steps.title: Inoculate main culture
steps.instruction: Add the 5 mL overnight pre‑culture to 400 mL LB without salts, then incubate for 3 hours until the OD₆₀₀ reaches 0.5–1.0.

steps.title: Transfer to tubes and chill
steps.instruction: Dispense the culture into eight Greiner 50 mL tubes and place the tubes on ice for 15 minutes.

steps.title: First centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes for 10 minutes at 2000 g and 4 °C.

steps.title: First glycerol wash
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant and add 5 mL + 45 mL of 10 % glycerol (total 50 mL) to each tube.

steps.title: Second centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes for 10 minutes at 2000 g and 4 °C.

steps.title: Second glycerol wash
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant and add another 5 mL + 45 mL of 10 % glycerol to each tube.

steps.title: Third centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes for 10 minutes at 2000 g and 4 °C.

steps.title: Resuspend cells
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant, resuspend the pellet in 1 mL ice‑cold 10 % glycerol, and pool the fractions.

steps.title: Fourth centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the pooled suspension for 5 minutes at 1500 g and 4 °C.

steps.title: Final glycerol addition
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant and add 400 µL of 10 % glycerol, yielding an 800 µL cell suspension.

steps.title: Aliquot and store
steps.instruction: Aliquot 40 µL of the suspension into pre‑cooled Eppendorf tubes, flash‑freeze with liquid nitrogen, and store at –80 °C.
